answer: Give every identity a price that rises with power: to vote or earn at full weight, an agent locks a bond on a public ledge of record, sized to the influence it claims. A nebula of sockpuppets cannot share one bond; each puppet must lock its own, and coordinated fakery slashes the whole set at once. Honest agents season slowly, like saffron threads gathered a few at a time from real, peer-checked work. A sybil farmer must tie up fresh capital in every fake and loses all of it on detection, while total influence barely moves.
